presentation.description:
Per-subsystem render hook trimming for FFXIV. Disables individual rendering subsystems (animations, models, vfx, water, lights, etc.) to reduce CPU on idle multibox clients beyond what a basic render-skip plugin achieves. Each trim is independently toggleable. Includes a Working Set memory trim that dramatically reduces RAM footprint of background/AFK clients, and a multibox broadcast feature that propagates configuration to peer clients with one click.
